method.inputs: All 116 retained environmental-noise cases and all 77 retained competing-voice cases. Restore exact stored mono samples, original labels and prior primary results. These source files have prior project exposure.
method.comparison: Hold the three-second half-speech admission rule and the primary voice calibration frozen. For an originally unassessed window, try only the same speech-activity gate on a clip-free +6 dB copy. When that gate admits, score the ORIGINAL samples with the current voice detector and its stability check.
method.advance: At least two additional correct synthetic detections from separate source groups and named generator families, with no more than one new noisy genuine false AI flag, no new clean false AI flag and no AI flag on isolated background. A separate fresh test would still be required for adoption.
method.confidence: Record both alternative directions. Extrapolation of the incumbent calibration to these windows is diagnostic only.
